projectName: i need a home media streaming app

nodes.label: main.ts
nodes.description: The entry point of the application. Initializes the server, loads configurations, and connects to the database. Imports services and UI components.

nodes.label: config.ts
nodes.description: Contains application configuration including network settings, database connection strings, and other constants. Uses environment variables for sensitive information.

nodes.label: database.ts
nodes.description: Manages database operations. Responsible for connecting to the database and executing queries on media files, streaming sessions, and user data.

nodes.label: media_service.ts
nodes.description: Handles the business logic for managing media files. Can include methods for uploading, organizing, and retrieving media data.

nodes.label: user_service.ts
nodes.description: Handles user authentication, authorization, and profile management. Includes methods for registering new users, logging in, and updating profiles.

nodes.label: stream_service.ts
nodes.description: Manages streaming sessions. Includes methods to initiate and terminate streams, handle user connections, and manage playback settings.

nodes.label: connection_service.ts
nodes.description: Handles network connections. Includes methods to detect available devices on the network and establish streaming sessions.

nodes.label: home_screen.tsx
nodes.description: The main user interface for the home screen. Displays a list of media files and streams available devices to stream to.

nodes.label: connection_screen.tsx
nodes.description: The user interface for managing streaming connections. Displays a list of active streams and allows users to initiate new sessions.

nodes.label: styles.css
nodes.description: Contains global styles for the application. Defines common UI elements like buttons, text, and backgrounds.

nodes.label: types.ts
nodes.description: Defines types and interfaces used throughout the application. Helps enforce data structure consistency across different parts of the codebase.

nodes.label: server.ts
nodes.description: Sets up the server using an Express.js framework. Defines routes and middleware for handling incoming requests.

nodes.label: validator.ts
nodes.description: Contains validation logic to ensure data integrity and error handling. Uses Joi for schema validation across different layers.

nodes.label: logger.ts
nodes.description: Handles logging throughout the application. Outputs logs to systemd journal for easy monitoring and debugging.

nodes.label: routes.ts
nodes.description: Defines API routes for the application. Includes endpoints for media management, user authentication, and stream control.

nodes.label: middleware.ts
nodes.description: Handles middleware functions for incoming requests. Includes authentication checking and other pre-request processing.

nodes.label: package.json
nodes.description: Metadata for the project including dependencies, scripts, and configuration settings. Used by npm to manage package installations and scripts.

nodes.label: tsconfig.json
nodes.description: Compiler options used by TypeScript for compiling the project. Defines configurations like target language, module system, and source map generation.

nodes.label: tslint.json
nodes.description: Configuration file for TypeScript linting rules to enforce code quality and consistency.

nodes.label: jest.config.js
nodes.description: Configuration file for Jest test runner including settings like coverage threshold and transform rules.

nodes.label: systemd.service
nodes.description: Systemd service file for packaging the application as a .deb file. Defines how the app is started and stopped on the system.
